purpose: This table provides a clean, deduplicated reference list of airline carriers with their IATA carrier codes and full legal names, intended to feed joins against flight-level fact tables keyed by carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join on the carrier column, which is unique across all 16 rows and never null; no filtering for flagged or duplicate rows is required since none were found in bronze.
limitations: The dataset is a small static reference list (16 rows) sourced at a single extraction timestamp; it does not capture carrier code reuse or historical name changes over time, and pipeline metadata columns were dropped entirely.
